evidence_items.explanation: This documents a full-year loss projection for OpenAI. It is neither realized quarterly cash consumption nor an industry total; news reporting is used because the underlying financial documents were not available in the reviewed record.

The announced credit facility was undrawn at closing. Its headline size therefore cannot be counted as outstanding borrowing, and this later disclosure does not establish industry leverage during the target quarter.

unresolved_gaps: No comparable industry-wide cash-flow and obligation data for the target quarter.
The claim supplies no accounting basis, preventing a supported or contradicted financial score under the specified rules.
Current or projected losses do not establish that no credible route to profitability exists.
The reviewed environmental research does not settle the physical and digital harm components for the specified period.
